info.name: feed-api
info.description:
All feed-api endpoints, one folder per route file (internal/routes/*_routes.go).

1. Start the API: go run ./cmd
2. Set the baseUrl collection variable if your server is not http://localhost:8080
3. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (requests run in order; some depend on earlier ones).
4. Test rows (vendors with external_id postman-test-*, product-hierarchy test departments) stay in the DB; delete them manually if needed.

Product Hierarchies scenarios 4, 5, 6 and 8 only show "inserted" on the first run.
